summary: A boolean toggle can reveal extra fields: define showAdvanced (default false) and under dependencies.showAdvanced.allOf add an if (showAdvanced const true) / then block adding maxSyncDelay. When the toggle is off the field is hidden and not submitted.
questions: How do I show advanced options only when a toggle is on in a self-service template?
Are hidden dynamic fields submitted with the form?
Show an example of a boolean toggle with dependencies

answer_card.title: Toggle extra fields with a boolean
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
properties:
  showAdvanced:
    title: Show advanced options?
    type: boolean
    default: false
dependencies:
  showAdvanced:
    allOf:
      - if:
          properties:
            showAdvanced:
              const: true
        then:
          properties:
            maxSyncDelay:
              type: number
              title: Max sync delay (ms)
              default: 500
```
When the toggle is off, `maxSyncDelay` is hidden and not submitted.
